rules.title: Externally observable behavior
rules.statement: Recommend persistent evidence when a distinct externally observable behavior changes and cheaper evidence does not already protect it.
rules.positive: A CLI command gains a new documented exit state; no test asserts the observable exit code.
rules.negative: A private helper is renamed while CLI output and existing tests remain unchanged.
rules.ambiguous: An exported function changes, but consumers and compatibility status are unknown; derive a candidate and disclose uncertainty.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Business or safety invariant
rules.statement: Prioritize authorization, accounting, idempotency, uniqueness, ordering, state transition, and irreversible-action invariants.
rules.positive: A payment retry path can emit the side effect twice and no invariant test exists.
rules.negative: A display-only sort preference changes with no persisted or contractual invariant.
rules.ambiguous: A function named authorizeTransfer changes but no policy or reachable boundary is known; infer only advisory obligation.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Confirmed regression
rules.statement: Add one focused regression guard only when a reproduced failure class is not already reliably detected.
rules.positive: A bug reproduction fails and no existing test covers retry after a failed claim.
rules.negative: An existing focused test already fails on the reproduced bug; fix code without adding a duplicate test.
rules.ambiguous: Issue text reports a bug but no reproduction exists; classify as candidate and request evidence.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Risky boundary
rules.statement: Place evidence at databases, queues, filesystems, networks, clocks, concurrency, serialization, providers, auth, or deployment boundaries when that is where failure occurs.
rules.positive: Transaction isolation behavior changes; recommend a compatible real-database integration test.
rules.negative: A pure string formatter changes; a database test would add no distinct signal.
rules.ambiguous: A wrapper may call a remote provider, but the configured adapter cannot determine whether the path is live or mocked.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Contracts and compatibility
rules.statement: Protect consumer/provider contracts, schemas, formats, migrations, and version windows.
rules.positive: A JSON response field becomes nullable and a consumer contract exists.
rules.negative: An internal temporary object shape changes without crossing a boundary.
rules.ambiguous: An exported TypeScript type changes but runtime consumers are unknown; report a derived contract candidate.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Critical journeys
rules.statement: Maintain a small number of system-level checks for explicitly critical user or operator journeys.
rules.positive: Login-to-checkout is configured critical and routing/auth wiring changes.
rules.negative: Every minor component visual variation receives a new end-to-end test.
rules.ambiguous: A workflow appears critical from naming but is not declared; advise declaration rather than gate.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Nonfunctional obligation
rules.statement: Use specialized evidence for security, privacy, accessibility, latency, resilience, recovery, and compliance at the observable scope.
rules.positive: A declared p95 latency budget changes in a hot path; recommend a benchmark at that boundary.
rules.negative: A pure unit test asserts elapsed wall time for a network service SLA.
rules.ambiguous: A comment claims compliance significance without a maintained policy; mark inferred and advisory.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: High-input-space behavior
rules.statement: Prefer property, fuzz, metamorphic, combinatorial, or model-based techniques when many inputs share invariant structure.
rules.positive: A parser change affects arbitrary escaped strings; recommend round-trip/property evidence.
rules.negative: A two-state boolean formatter receives 100 enumerated examples.
rules.ambiguous: The domain may be open-ended but no invariant is explicit; recommend an invariant discovery step, not automatic fuzzing.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Cheapest valid scope
rules.statement: Choose the least expensive scope that can trigger the relevant failure mechanism and observe the contract.
rules.positive: Pure tax calculation is covered by a narrow property test.
rules.negative: A mocked unit test is selected for a database uniqueness constraint.
rules.ambiguous: A service wrapper could fail in transformation or provider wiring; recommend both candidate scopes with unresolved distinction.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Do not test below the failure boundary
rules.statement: Reject a lower-level test when the failure requires real wiring, state, or environment.
rules.positive: Queue acknowledgement ordering is tested with a faithful queue harness.
rules.negative: A policy helper unit test is claimed to prove HTTP middleware registration.
rules.ambiguous: The repository uses a custom in-memory emulator whose fidelity is undocumented; disclose uncertainty.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Documentation/comments
rules.statement: Documentation or comment-only changes default to NO_TEST unless executable documentation or generated contracts change.
rules.positive: README wording only.
rules.negative: OpenAPI generated from Markdown changes.
rules.ambiguous: A code block may be executed by docs CI, but no docs config is available.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Formatting/mechanical refactor
rules.statement: Formatting or mechanically proven refactors run affected existing checks and ordinarily add no tests.
rules.positive: Prettier-only diff with AST equivalence.
rules.negative: A “formatting” commit changes a string literal.
rules.ambiguous: Parser diagnostics prevent proving AST equivalence.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Behavior-preserving structural refactor
rules.statement: Preserve existing behavior tests; substantial test churn is a smell.
rules.positive: Extract function without contract change; existing tests remain stable.
rules.negative: Refactor changes retry ownership and requires boundary evidence.
rules.ambiguous: AST says signatures unchanged but dynamic behavior cannot be established without running tests.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: New pure behavior
rules.statement: Add or update focused behavior evidence for meaningful partitions and invariants.
rules.positive: New deterministic discount rule with boundary values.
rules.negative: New alias delegates unchanged behavior.
rules.ambiguous: Function includes hidden I/O despite pure-looking signature.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Confirmed bug
rules.statement: Find why evidence missed the bug and add one guard for that failure class only when needed.
rules.positive: Reproduced zero-value parsing bug lacks a guard.
rules.negative: Existing test already reproduces and fails.
rules.ambiguous: Bug report lacks a minimal reproduction.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Boundary/dependency change
rules.statement: Test at the real boundary or contract; mocks serve fault injection or rare states, not wiring proof.
rules.positive: Webhook persistence claim/release changes; add integration retry test.
rules.negative: Internal helper call changes only.
rules.ambiguous: Dependency upgrade changelog is unavailable and behavior impact is unknown.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Schema/migration change
rules.statement: Use compatibility, migration, rollback, and data-preservation evidence where applicable.
rules.positive: Non-null migration with backfill and rollback requirements.
rules.negative: Type-only local interface rename.
rules.ambiguous: Schema file changed but generation provenance is unknown.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Concurrency/ordering change
rules.statement: Use deterministic invariant evidence plus stress or schedule exploration when practical.
rules.positive: Lock/ack order changes in queue consumer.
rules.negative: Synchronous immutable map rename.
rules.ambiguous: Concurrency is hidden behind a third-party scheduler with no harness.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Security-sensitive change
rules.statement: Derive tests from a declared or observed threat at the reachable boundary.
rules.positive: Signature verification middleware changes; test forged request rejection and no side effect.
rules.negative: Private helper comment mentions security without reachable use.
rules.ambiguous: Potential auth path inferred from names only.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Generated code
rules.statement: Test the generator or contract rather than every generated line unless artifacts are independently owned.
rules.positive: Generator template changes output schema; test generator contract.
rules.negative: Add one test per regenerated client method.
rules.ambiguous: Generated file changes without source mapping; return insufficient evidence.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Configuration/deployment change
rules.statement: Use validation, smoke, and production-like wiring evidence rather than source-level unit tests.
rules.positive: Route configuration changes service wiring; add config validation/smoke.
rules.negative: Unit-test a constant copied from YAML.
rules.ambiguous: Configuration may be inert in current environment; deployment mapping absent.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Uncustomized dependency behavior
rules.statement: Do not test framework, language, ORM, serializer, client, or standard-library behavior the repository does not customize.
rules.positive: A test merely proves Array.sort sorts.
rules.negative: Custom serializer option changes wire compatibility.
rules.ambiguous: Wrapper configuration may alter defaults but config execution is untrusted.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Trivial accessors and pass-throughs
rules.statement: Do not test trivial getters, setters, constants, aliases, or pass-throughs without policy, transformation, side effect, or compatibility obligation.
rules.positive: Getter returns one field unchanged.
rules.negative: Wrapper enforces tenant filtering before delegation.
rules.ambiguous: Pass-through adds logging whose compliance significance is unknown.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Private methods and call order
rules.statement: Do not freeze private methods or internal call order when public behavior captures the contract.
rules.positive: Test asserts three internal method calls in exact order.
rules.negative: Call ordering is itself a declared transaction invariant.
rules.ambiguous: Mocks suggest order matters but no observable failure is identified.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Compile/type guarantees
rules.statement: Do not repeat compiler or type-system guarantees at runtime unless untyped/serialized input crosses a boundary.
rules.positive: Runtime test asserts a TypeScript-only union rejects compilation.
rules.negative: JSON input is validated at runtime against the union contract.
rules.ambiguous: Build uses transpile-only mode and type checking is not confirmed.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Mock interaction theater
rules.statement: Do not assert every internal mock call when state, output, or external contract matters.
rules.positive: Test checks private collaborator call count but no outcome.
rules.negative: Mock injects provider timeout to assert observable retry policy.
rules.ambiguous: Only a mock is available for an external dependency; wiring confidence remains limited.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Coverage chasing
rules.statement: Do not add cases solely to execute every syntactic branch.
rules.positive: Test adds an impossible branch case to raise coverage.
rules.negative: Uncovered branch corresponds to a plausible authorization denial.
rules.ambiguous: Branch plausibility is unknown from static facts.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Duplicate equivalence examples
rules.statement: Do not add multiple examples from one equivalence class without a new boundary, invariant, or domain distinction.
rules.positive: Tests repeat three ordinary positive integers.
rules.negative: Zero, maximum, and negative values represent distinct partitions.
rules.ambiguous: Domain boundaries are undocumented; advise domain clarification.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Cross-layer duplication
rules.statement: Do not repeat the same behavior at unit, integration, and E2E scopes unless each detects a distinct failure mechanism.
rules.positive: All three tests assert the same pure calculation.
rules.negative: Unit proves calculation; integration proves database constraint; E2E proves auth/routing wiring.
rules.ambiguous: Layer overlap exists but unique mechanism cannot be established.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Blind snapshots
rules.statement: Do not rely on broad snapshots without a named semantic contract and review process.
rules.positive: Agent regenerates a 2,000-line UI snapshot after every change.
rules.negative: Golden protocol fixture has reviewed versioning and compatibility purpose.
rules.ambiguous: Snapshot is small but its contract is undocumented.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Speculative edge cases
rules.statement: Do not generate edge cases with no plausible likelihood or impact.
rules.positive: Agent enumerates exotic Unicode combinations for an internal identifier with no external input.
rules.negative: Parser accepts adversarial external Unicode and has a security history.
rules.ambiguous: Exposure is unknown; return candidate with uncertainty.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: Replacement-freeze tests
rules.statement: Do not add tests whose only purpose is to freeze internals during planned replacement; characterize the replacement boundary.
rules.positive: Tests pin each private method before a rewrite.
rules.negative: Contract characterization protects migration output compatibility.
rules.ambiguous: Replacement boundary is not documented.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.

rules.title: File-changed test reflex
rules.statement: Do not create a test solely because an agent edited a file.
rules.positive: Comment change causes a new unit test.
rules.negative: File edit changes an unguarded public behavior.
rules.ambiguous: Diff mixes docs and behavior and cannot be cleanly classified.
rules.low: Emit advisory or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never gate.
